The old edge id survives only inside the two handoff records as quoted history. The trace test asserts equality with ['end-disbursed'] (line 177); the held helper asserts equality with ['end-disbursement-held'] (line 337) and refutes 'end-disbursed' (line 338). The single targeted run passed all 7 tests, which confirms the positive values. The fail direction of the refute was confirmed by reading only; no mutation was run.
